map.做 Tabata/循环训练（HIIT）时，按「训练+休息」轮次自动倒计时，解放双: For Tabata/circuit training (HIIT), it counts down through work and rest rounds automatically so you do not have to watch the clock.
map.可复现算例：40/20 × 8 轮的总时长: Reproducible example: total duration of 40/20 × 8 rounds
map.新手建议 20–30s 训练+20–30s 休息、6–8 轮；进阶可 40s 训: Beginners: 20–30s work + 20–30s rest, 6–8 rounds; advanced: 40s work + 15–20s rest, 8–12 rounds
Beginners: 20–30s work + 20–30s rest, 6–8 rounds; advanced: 40s work + 15–20s rest, 8–12 rounds. Total duration ≈ (work+rest)×rounds, so work backwards from your schedule.
map.规划一次训练的总时长：单轮时长×轮数+准备倒计时，便于排入日程。: Plan the total session length: single round length × rounds + ready countdown, so it fits the schedule.
map.计时器支持跳过当前阶段直接进入下一 phase（准备→训练→休息→完成），便于临: The timer can skip the current phase and jump straight to the next (ready → work → rest → done), which helps when plans change; the cumulative record stores the actual completed work count and minutes.
map.调整 work/rest/rounds 适配不同水平（新手长休息、进阶短休息多轮: Adjust work/rest/rounds for different levels (beginners rest longer, advanced rest less with more rounds).
